modules.title: Studio core
modules.description: Items, labels, all-annotations and AI panels; selection and navigation commands; select / pan / window-level tools; core geometries.

modules.title: 2D overlay tools
modules.description: Box, ellipse, polygon, freehand, polyline, spline, keypoint, brush and eraser on any image-plane renderer.

modules.title: Cornerstone3D tools
modules.description: Radiology tools on Cornerstone3D viewports: zoom, crosshairs, ROI shapes, measurements, threshold brush, flood fill, view transforms.

modules.title: Timeline tools
modules.description: Label spans and point-in-time events on any renderer with a time axis.

modules.title: File view
modules.description: Shows any file as metadata, a preview when possible and a download link: the fallback for kinds a Studio doesn't map.

modules.title: Generic files
modules.description: One item per file of any format, for sandboxed viewers (studio.sandbox-frame.v1 renderers) of formats the Studio doesn't read.

modules.title: 2D images
modules.description: Single-frame images (PNG, JPEG, single-frame DICOM): a Cornerstone3D stack viewport with window/level, measurements and masks for radiology, or a light canvas renderer with boxes, polygons and keypoints for natural images.

modules.title: 3D volumes
modules.description: NIfTI and DICOM series on Cornerstone3D MPR viewports (axial / coronal / sagittal + 3D) with crosshairs, 3D labelmaps and measurements.

modules.title: Multichannel time series
modules.description: Sampled signals (WFDB, CSV) on a strip chart: spans and instants per channel, a record-level track, delineation, beat detection and calipers.

modules.title: Video
modules.description: Frame-accurate video (mp4 / webm) with tracks interpolated between keyframes, per-frame shapes, segments and events on a timeline.

modules.title: Slice × frame cine
modules.description: Any slice × frame image series (4D NIfTI, e.g. cardiac cine MRI): contours and masks per slice and frame, key frames, playback, copy-forward, interpolation and reference import.

modules.title: Cardiac function metrics
modules.description: EDV, ESV, SV, EF, LV mass and Dice vs reference for a cardiac cine (Simpson's method of discs), as a right panel and a CSV export.

modules.title: Tiled image pyramids
modules.description: Deep-zoom image pyramids (DZI) on OpenSeadragon with vector regions, brush/eraser on regions, magic wand, point counting and µm measurements.

modules.title: DICOM export
modules.description: Masks as DICOM SEG and measurements as DICOM SR (TID 1500), referencing the source DICOM images.

modules.title: Text spans
modules.description: Plain-text documents with character-offset span labels (named entities, phrases); JSONL export in the spaCy / doccano shape.

modules.title: Table
modules.description: Tabular files (CSV; Parquet and Arrow matched) on a row grid: label rows or cells, review conflicting row labels, export CSV with labels joined.

modules.title: Charts
modules.description: Time-series lines and open/high/low/close candles over table rows, Vega-Lite specs, and window (span) and event (instant) annotations on the time axis.

modules.title: Segmentation
modules.description: Segment objects in images from text, point or box prompts, or a named prompt recipe (label `lungs`: two boxes sized to a frontal chest X-ray, masks named right lung and left lung). Text prompts don't work on radiographs; use a recipe there. Mock provider for CI; Meta SAM (hosted) and a self-hosted SAM endpoint as configurable providers.

modules.title: Presets
modules.description: Ready-made environments: the six medical Studios and generic starting points. Use with `extends`.

contributions.description: One .nii.gz labelmap of the subject open in the studio; geometry copied from its own scan. BraTS values 1/2/4, otherwise label index + 1.

contributions.description: Every subject's masks as run-length encoded voxel grids (x fastest, background first) with label values, voxel counts and volumes.
contributions.label: Masks JSON (all subjects)

contributions.description: MIT-format <record>.atr (beats, rhythm changes, noise) plus LUDB-style per-lead wave files (<record>.i, .ii … with ( peak ) triplets), the source .hea headers and a RECORDS list. Readable with rdann / wfdb-python.
contributions.label: WFDB annotations (.tar)

noise.description: Regular expression (case-insensitive) on the label of intervals written as NOISE (~) episodes

contributions.description: Per record: beats, P/QRS/T waves (onset/peak/offset), rhythm episodes, intervals and record statements, in seconds and sample indices.
contributions.label: ECG delineation (LUDB JSON)

contributions.description: One row per interval, wave and rhythm episode: record, kind, lead, label, start/end in s and samples, duration in ms, provenance.
contributions.label: Intervals & waves (CSV)

contributions.description: One annotations XML per video: tracks with every frame interpolated (keyframe, outside, occluded flags); per-frame shapes as one-frame tracks.
contributions.label: CVAT for video 1.1

contributions.description: Box tracks per video as gt/gt.txt (frame, id, x, y, w, h, conf, class, visibility; 1-based frames) with seqinfo.ini.
contributions.label: MOT challenge CSV

contributions.description: Labeled segments and point-in-time events per video, in seconds and frames.
contributions.label: Temporal JSON

contributions.description: 4D uint8 .nii.gz on the cine's grid and orientation; value = label position (1 = RV, 2 = MYO, 3 = LV for ACDC labels). Frames without contours are zero.
contributions.label: ACDC labelmap (NIfTI)

contributions.description: Every contour with its spline control points, densely sampled outline, slice, frame, area and source.
contributions.label: Contours (JSON)

contributions.description: Per-frame, per-slice RV/MYO/LV areas and volumes, plus EDV, ESV, SV, EF and LV mass (Simpson's method of discs).
contributions.label: Cardiac function (CSV)

contributions.description: Regions, lines and per-class point sets in level-0 pixels with classifications and measurements. Opens in QuPath (File › Import objects), Cytomine and DSA.
contributions.label: QuPath GeoJSON

contributions.description: ASAP / CAMELYON annotation XML: polygons, rectangles, point sets and groups per class; holes become <class>_exclusion polygons.
contributions.label: ASAP XML

contributions.description: Per-slide, per-class point counts with region count, region area and points/mm².
contributions.label: Cell counts CSV

contributions.description: Masks as a DICOM Segmentation object referencing the source DICOM images (one segment per label). DICOM inputs only.
contributions.label: DICOM SEG (current item)

contributions.description: Lengths, angles, ROIs, probes and arrows as a DICOM Structured Report (TID 1500). DICOM inputs only.
contributions.label: DICOM SR measurements (current item)

contributions.description: One line per document: {"text", "spans": [[start, end, label]…]}, readable by spaCy and doccano.
contributions.label: Spans JSONL

contributions.description: The table(s) as CSV with a `file` column and a `label` column joined from row labels.
contributions.label: CSV with labels
